open_questions: Chemistry is recorded from SDS DL2-15235.pdf, Section 3: Distillates (petroleum), hydrotreated light paraffinic; CAS 64742-55-8.
Specific gravity at 15/4°C is dimensionless and must not be transcribed directly as absolute density.
No grade-specific CCS viscosity or CCS test temperature has been verified for Ultra-S 2.
Noack volatility is marked with a dash in the Ultra-S 2 column and must remain Missing.
Final source-level reconciliation between DL2-11177.pdf and DL2-15235.pdf remains pending.

API Group (2026-10 audit): previously recorded as 'Group III' (Reported, no source; printed_text 'aramcoULTRA (Group III); S-OIL states Ultra-S and aramcoULTRA have the same properties'; note 'Classification supported by manufacturer-published Ultra-S/aramcoULTRA equivalence; not directly stated in the historical grade-specific SDS.'). No archived or public S-OIL document classifies Ultra-S 2 directly, so the field is now Missing. Indirect evidence only, not a classification of Ultra-S: (1) S-OIL states 'Ultra-S base oil is S-OIL's own brand product and has the same properties with armcoULTRA base oil' and lists identical typical properties for Ultra-S 2 and aramcoULTRA 2 (https://www.s-oil.com/en/energy/LubeBaseOil.aspx, undated, retrieved 2026-10-21); (2) the Aramco base-oil catalog 2024 p.24 lists aramcoULTRA 2 as API Base Oil Category Group II, and p.23 states 'These grades of aramcoULTRA are not classified as API Group III' for aramcoULTRA 2 and 3 (https://www.aramco.com/-/media/downloads/creating-value/base-oils/aramco-base-oil-catalog-2024.pdf). Documentation discrepancy, not a conflict between Ultra-S specifications: the S-OIL page labels the aramcoULTRA brand as a whole 'aramcoULTRA (Group Ⅲ)', whereas the Aramco catalog classifies the aramcoULTRA 2 grade as Group II. Neither document classifies Ultra-S 2. Confirm the API Group of Ultra-S 2 with S-OIL.
